Bahrain's military says it intercepted Iranian drones aimed at a US base on 15 November, Iran's second attack on the kingdom in three days; Bahrain's foreign ministry condemned it.
The US aircraft carrier Theodore Roosevelt has entered the Middle East, a US official says, making three US carriers in the region.
China confirmed Xi Jinping will host Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen on 19 November, the first three-way summit; Beijing says it will cover world peace and strategic stability.
Estonia blamed Russia's military intelligence for an arson attempt at a drone maker and plans to close three road crossings with Russia from 1 December; eight people were detained.
Yemen's Saudi-backed forces withdrew from the Bab al-Mandab area to defend Aden; the Houthis say they have retaken it and are about 60 km from the city.
A tanker leaving the Gulf was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz on 16 November, causing a fire but no injuries, UK maritime authorities said.
Ukraine attacked the Crimean Bridge overnight, forcing its closure; Russia says it downed more than 1,300 Ukrainian drones.
Trump told Vice-President Vance to stop working on Iran talks, saying the US no longer needs a deal with Tehran.
